lots.guide_summary: All surviving evidence is SOLD, none of it the same item. The three close comparables (small mixed record lots incl a Beatles item at Gowans, Hobart, 2026) made $15, $35 and $60 hammer. Category guides: Gowans boxes of records incl Beatles $45 to $160, single Beatles items $40 to $70, and a standard UK 'With the Beatles' on eBay about AUD 101 to 182 (USD 1 = AUD 1.53). No UNSOLD or ASKING evidence. The variant 'With the Beatles' cover is unpriced.
lots.working: No same-item SOLD entry exists: a mixed lot can only be matched loosely, and the 'With the Beatles' variant (country and label unread) has no price evidence. So both maxima are 0 under the rules. For context only, the close Gowans lots ($15 to $60 hammer) would put a keep ceiling around $15/1.22 = $12 to $60/1.22 = $49 hammer, rounded to $10 to $45. Flip: resale of a mixed common-title lot after about 13% marketplace fees and postage leaves too little to divide by 2.44, so 0.
lots.confidence_reason: Identification of the bulk is clear, but the one item that could carry value (the variant 'With the Beatles') has an unread label and country and no price evidence. Comparables are close-not-same mixed lots, and WebSearch was unavailable (session budget used), so no Armitage past results or Discogs check.

lots.key_photo_findings: One photo, enlarged. Cups have the scalloped batwing border in cobalt (three), red and turquoise; at least two cups carry a gilt script inscription (possibly 'A Present from' or a name, unreadable), which suggests souvenir ware and may not be Coalport. Bowl has a gilt flower spray. Amber plates are moulded glass with a central bird or fish. Brown platters look like glazed earthenware with hanging wire. Small blue and white plates are a floral transfer, some appear to have fluted rims. No marks visible; no chips or cracks visible at this resolution.
